fn expressions(xs: &[u64], a: u64) -> bool
  ! pure
  requires true
  ensures pkg::f(a).m(a).field == a
  ensures result == (|x| x + 1)
  ensures result == match a { 0 => true, _ => false }
  ensures result == if true { true } else { false }
  ensures result == (xs[a] == a)
  ensures result == (a as u64 == a)
  ensures result == (&a == &a)
  ensures result == !true
  ensures result == "x"
{
  true
}
